s.note: Crisp battered fish bites with tartare and lemon.
s.how: Stir the mayo with the capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon. Whisk the flours, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a light batter. Dip the fish and fry in oil at 180C in batches until crisp. Drain, salt and serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.

s.note: Salted dough twists baked deep brown, with hot cheddar to dip.
s.how: Roll the dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Drop them in batches into simmering water with the bicarb for 30 seconds, then drain. Brush with egg, sprinkle with salt and bake at 220C until deep brown. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick, then melt in the cheddar and mustard.

m.note: Jerk chicken thighs, rice and peas, charred lime.
m.how: Rub the chicken with the jerk paste and oil. Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, spring onions, thyme and 250ml water, covered, until tender. Grill the chicken over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through. Char the lime halves on the grill. Serve the chicken on the rice and peas with the lime.

m.note: Cheese-stuffed Minneapolis beef burgers, pickles, onions. Morris tips the waitress then wants it back.
m.how: Divide the mince into 8 thin patties. Fold 2 slices of cheese into a square on 4 patties, top with the others and pinch the edges tightly shut. Cook in a hot pan, 5 minutes a side, pricking once so the steam escapes. Serve in buns with onion, pickles and mustard, and warn everyone the cheese is molten.

w.note: Blackberry and blueberry cobbler with vanilla cream.
w.how: Toss the berries with 100g of the sugar and the cornflour and tip into a baking dish. Rub the butter into the flour and the rest of the sugar, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls over the fruit and bake at 190C until golden and bubbling. Stir the vanilla into the cream and pour over to serve.

d.note: Blackcurrant and lemon topped with sparkling wine.
d.how: Put 20ml cordial, a squeeze of lemon and 3 frozen blueberries in each of 4 flutes. Top slowly with the sparkling wine.
